message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine charges. Facts: a police auxiliary (协警) who is a state employee (国家机关工作人员) helped a drug dealer hide seized methamphetamine, concealed two bags in his uniform pocket, later buried one bag, later flushed one bag down toilet, surrendered, confessed. He helped conceal drug evidence, aiding drug trafficker to evade law. This is likely "帮助犯罪分子隐匿、转移、毁灭犯罪所得、犯罪工具、犯罪证据罪" under Chinese criminal law, article 304? Actually article 304 of Criminal Law: "帮助犯罪分子隐匿、转移、毁灭犯罪所得、犯罪工具、犯罪证据的，处三年以下有期徒刑或者拘役，并处或者单处罚金；情节严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑。" Since he is a state employee, maybe also "徇私枉法" but main is "帮助犯罪分子隐匿、转移、毁灭犯罪所得、犯罪工具、犯罪证据罪". Also could be "受贿"? No. Not bribery. Not forgery. So single charge.

Thus output: [罪名]帮助犯罪分子隐匿、转移、毁灭犯罪所得、犯罪工具、犯罪证据罪<eoa>

Check correction rules: none about multiple. So final JSON with reasoning and final answer.
